newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech blue chips rally to push PX50 index higher.
newsitem.headline: Czech blue chips rally to push PX50 index higher.

text.p: Major Czech shares fell early on the Prague Stock Exchange on Wednesday, but rallied in continuous trading to push the PX50 index 0.1 point higher to close at 508.2.
Komercni Banka, down 21 crowns at midday, rebounded slightly to close 12 crowns lower at 1,739, while CEZ gained five crowns in late trading to close at 920.
Although the index edged up for the first time in three sessions, dealers were still bearish on the short-term future of the bourse, which has been on a gradual downturn for several months.
Overall on the bourse, 110 issues rose, while 94 fell and 59 held steady. Total volume was moderate at 944,862 shares on turnover of 1.33 billion crowns.
